faults.quote: Use 'pagar por' when you want to emphasize the specific object
faults.why: Misleading: normal Spanish uses 'pagar' transitively ('pagar las entradas'), unlike English 'pay for'.

faults.quote: Voy a pagar por los boletos.
faults.why: 'Boletos' is not Castilian Spanish ('entradas'/'billetes'), and 'pagar por' is an Anglicism here.
